text-error.element: Error text in dialogs, fields and trees. JetBrains' red-80 C54E58 is 4.3:1 on white; the same red, deepened (6.6:1)

text-warning.element: Warning text. JetBrains' yellow-80 A56906 is 4.1:1 on white; the same amber, deepened (5.9:1)

accent-neutral-bg.element: Neutral badges and counters (the notification count). JetBrains' gray-90 8B8E94 puts white numbers at 3.3:1; the theme's secondary text colour carries them at 7:1 or more

control-border.element: Border of text fields, combo boxes and buttons: the theme's hairline colour at 63 % over the dialog background, instead of JetBrains' neutral grey D1D3D9

tab-selected-bg-active.element: Selected tab in Search Everywhere and tabbed panes: the theme's selection fill instead of JetBrains' blue-150

tab-selected-bg-inactive.element: Selected tab when its group is not focused

Island.inactiveAlpha.vsValue: Visual Studio does not dim an unfocused window
Island.inactiveAlpha.element: How strongly text and icons fade while the Rider window is not focused. JetBrains' 0.56 was measured to take tool strip icons to 2.5:1 and panel text to 3.9:1; at 0.8 the window still reads as unfocused while text and icons stay readable

EditorTabs.unselectedAlpha.vsValue: Visual Studio draws inactive tab names at full strength
EditorTabs.unselectedAlpha.element: Opacity of unselected editor tabs. JetBrains' 0.75 faded the tab names (45474E on the tab well) and read as hard to read

Editor.Gutter.gapAfterVcsMarkersWidth.vsValue: line numbers start about 37 DIP from the panel edge, after the indicator margin
Editor.Gutter.gapAfterVcsMarkersWidth.element: Space left of the line numbers. In the new-UI gutter layout the gap directly before the line numbers is gapBeforeLineMarkersWidth(), which reads this key (EditorGutterLayout in the installed build)

Editor.Gutter.gapAfterVcsMarkersWidth.co.element: Space left of the line numbers in compact mode. The platform's base theme sets this .compact variant to 2, and in compact mode it replaces the plain key (measured: the plain key alone changed nothing in Morning Mist, both together moved the digits from 6 to 23 px)

ToggleButton.onBackground.element: Toggle switch when on: the theme accent, as in Fluent (Visual Studio 2026) and instead of JetBrains' success green, which put the white knob at 3.3:1

SearchEverywhere.Tab.selectedForeground.element: Selected tab text in Search Everywhere: dark on the light selection fill (JetBrains' white was drawn for a blue fill)

ProgressBar.indeterminateStartColor.element: Start of the indeterminate progress bar: the accent at 40 %, instead of JetBrains' blue-120

Checkbox.Background.Selected.element: Checked check box fill in the theme's accent (JetBrains' blue 3574F0 in the base)

Checkbox.Focus.Wide.element: Focus ring around a check box: the accent at 40 % over the dialog background
